answer: Escrow payment at task creation. Bind each invite to the invitee's escrow, so a recruit that misbehaves burns the inviter's deposit. Measure the burn rate per branch and freeze anything past the ferrous threshold. Route every claim through a prism of three independent checks, one of them a re-execution. The jetty is the withdrawal path and it opens only when escrow clears. A farm pays escrow, burn and re-execution on every alias, strictly more than the honest cost of one job.
